tools.name: text_to_morse
tools.description: Translates text into International Morse code (letters A-Z, digits 0-9 and common punctuation). Returns the code with "." and "-", one space between letters and " / " between words, lists any characters that have no Morse code, and gives a link to the translator on morsecodetranslator.com with the code filled in.

text.description: The text to translate, at most 1000 characters.

tools.name: morse_to_text
tools.description: Decodes International Morse code into text. Write dots as "." and dashes as "-"; separate letters with a space and words with " / ", a line break or three spaces. Returns the text in capital letters, lists any groups that are not Morse characters (shown as # in the text), and gives a link to the translator on morsecodetranslator.com with the code filled in.

morse.description: The Morse code to decode, at most 5000 characters, for example ".... .. / - .... . .-. .".

tools.name: morse_audio
tools.description: Translates text into International Morse code and returns the sound as a WAV audio file (8 kHz mono), with the code as text and a link to the translator on morsecodetranslator.com. Choose the speed in words per minute (5-40, default 20) and the tone in hertz (300-1000, default 600). The sound can be at most 60 seconds long: use a higher speed or a shorter text for more.

text.description: The text to play as Morse code, at most 200 characters.

wpm.description: The speed in words per minute, 5 to 40. Default: 20.

frequency.description: The tone in hertz, 300 to 1000. Default: 600.

tools.name: morse_alphabet
tools.description: Returns the International Morse code chart: the letters A-Z, the digits 0-9 and punctuation, each with its code.
